spec.description: Whether every database pg-autodump dumps has a fresh, good dump, with what needs your attention, and how the dumps and the free space change over time. The attention tiles need the rules from alerts/promql.yaml loaded.

spec.title: Dumps
spec.description: Shows while the PgAutodumpDumpFailed alert fires: the latest dump of a database failed, so its backup is getting older. The Databases table names it, and the container log says why. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Newest dump
spec.description: Shows while the PgAutodumpDumpStale alert fires: a database has had no new dump in 50 hours. Check that the timer or your trigger still runs. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: pg-autodump scrape
spec.description: Shows while the PgAutodumpDown alert fires: no scrape of pg-autodump has succeeded for 5 minutes. The tile counts every pg-autodump, because a missing target carries no instance. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Last run
spec.description: Whether every database dumped and checked in the latest run. Failed means at least one did not, and the Databases table names it. No value means no run has ended yet, or pg-autodump was not scraped.

spec.title: Last run ended
spec.description: When the latest run ended, kept across a restart. With the default 24-hour DUMP_INTERVAL, a time over a day ago means the timer or your trigger has stopped. No value means no run has ended yet, or pg-autodump was not scraped.

spec.title: Databases
spec.description: How many databases pg-autodump dumps, one per entry in DB_SPECS. A number lower than you configured means it runs an older configuration. No value means pg-autodump was not scraped.

spec.title: Free space
spec.description: Space left for dumps on the filesystem that holds the dump folder. A dump that does not fit fails, and the last good one stays. No value means pg-autodump could not read the folder or was not scraped.

spec.title: Databases
spec.description: One row per database: whether its latest dump succeeded, the age of its newest dump, its size, how long the latest attempt took, and the dumps that failed in the selected range. Dump age turns yellow at 48 hours, twice the default 24-hour DUMP_INTERVAL. Failures leave out dumps a stop cut short. Size and Duration read - until the first run after a start, and Latest dump until the database has a dump or a failure.

spec.expr: max by (server, db) (pg_autodump_dump_ok{instance="$instance"} == 0 or (pg_autodump_dump_ok{instance="$instance"} and on (server, db) pg_autodump_newest_dump_timestamp_seconds{instance="$instance"}))

defaults.noValue: No databases, or pg-autodump was not scraped

spec.title: Free space for dumps
spec.description: Space left on the filesystem that holds the dump folder, over the selected range. A line falling toward zero is the warning before a dump fails to fit. A gap means pg-autodump was not scraped.

spec.title: Dump size per database
spec.description: The size of each database's latest good dump, over the selected range. A sudden drop can mean a table was emptied, and steady growth tells you how fast the free space goes. A gap means pg-autodump was not scraped.

spec.title: pg-autodump

spec.name: instance
spec.label: pg-autodump
spec.description: The pg-autodump to show, by its scrape instance. Each container dumps its own list of databases.

spec.name: spanread
spec.label: Range length source
spec.description: Reads the length of the time range for span, spanunit and spanthe, all their words in one answer.

spec.query: query_result(label_replace(label_replace(count_values by (u) ("n", label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 86400), 0.1) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 172800), "u", "days", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 3600), 0.1) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 7200), "u", "hours", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 60)) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 120), "u", "minutes", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s)), "u", "seconds", "", "")), "n", "$1 : ", "n", "(.+)"), "u", "$1 : ", "u", "(.+)"))

spec.definition: query_result(label_replace(label_replace(count_values by (u) ("n", label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 86400), 0.1) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 172800), "u", "days", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 3600), 0.1) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 7200), "u", "hours", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 60)) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 120), "u", "minutes", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s)), "u", "seconds", "", "")), "n", "$1 : ", "n", "(.+)"), "u", "$1 : ", "u", "(.+)"))

spec.name: span
spec.label: Range length
spec.description: The number of the dashboard time range's length, such as "30" in "30 days", from spanread. It reads "the" until spanread has read a length.

spec.name: spanunit
spec.label: Range unit
spec.description: The unit of the dashboard time range's length, such as "days" in "30 days", from spanread. It reads "range" until spanread has read a length.

spec.name: spanthe
spec.label: Range length with its article
spec.description: The word "the" and the number of the dashboard time range's length, such as "the 30" in "the 30 days", from spanread. It reads "the" until spanread has read a length.

spec.name: attention
spec.label: Attention tiles shown
spec.description: How many Needs attention tiles have data. The row shows only while one does.

spec.query: query_result(count(label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="PgAutodumpDumpFailed", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "1", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="PgAutodumpDumpStale", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "2", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="PgAutodumpDown", alertstate="firing"})), "tile", "3", "", "")) or vector(0))

spec.definition: query_result(count(label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="PgAutodumpDumpFailed", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "1", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="PgAutodumpDumpStale", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "2", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="PgAutodumpDown", alertstate="firing"})), "tile", "3", "", "")) or vector(0))
